paper.title_en: Unitary coboundary weak quasi-Hopf algebras in the Kazhdan-Lusztig-Finkelberg theorem
paper.abstract_en: We construct, for every complex simple Lie algebra g and every positive integer level k, a unitary modular tensor category structure on the module category of the affine vertex operator algebra V_{g_k}, equivalent to the quantum group fusion category C(g,q,l), within the Doplicher-Roberts quantum group duality program for the Wess-Zumino-Witten model. The construction reaches positive integer levels that Finkelberg's argument does not cover, namely E_6 and E_7 at k=1 and E_8 at k=2, and it treats simply-laced and non-simply-laced types uniformly, whereas the Kazhdan-Lusztig construction was carried out for the simply-laced case. We establish that a weak quasi-fibre structure on a functor preserving a coboundary symmetry in the sense of Drinfeld extends a symmetric functor under permutation symmetry. Using Wenzl's functor, we construct such a structure compatible with the associativity morphisms, yielding unitary coboundary weak Hopf C*-algebras for all Lie types and positive integer levels. Via a specialized Drinfeld twist and the Wenzl de-quantization curve, this structure is transported onto the Zhu algebra, which becomes a unitary coboundary weak quasi-Hopf C*-algebra with a 3-coboundary associator. Rigidity is obtained from the quantum group side, without the Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equations or the Verlinde formula. Our methods settle several further problems: Galindo's question on the uniqueness of unitary tensor structures, Kirillov's conjecture on the positivity of a Hermitian form on the Beilinson-Feigin-Mazur category, the quantum group structure on the Zhu algebra sought by Frenkel and Zhu, and the Kazhdan-Lusztig-Finkelberg equivalence for all Lie types and levels without passing through the negative shifted levels, as raised by Huang. We also compare our structure with that of Huang and Lepowsky, and analyze the type A case via Kazhdan-Wenzl theory.
